resolved_since_the_previous_version: deploy/compose-network.test.sh: the hosted failure was environmental, not a defect of docker-compose.yml. In the suite private HOME the docker CLI (29.5.3) lists the system Compose plugin v5.1.4 but answers "unknown command: docker compose"; the runner user resolves Compose only through ~/.docker/cli-plugins (v5.4.0), which a private HOME hides (variants measured on the runner: HOME unset or empty env -> v5.4.0 resolves; HOME=<private dir> or /nonexistent -> unknown command). The script now classifies this precisely and runs the root-owned system Compose directly (hash and version printed); on the hosted runner the row verifies.
